long_biography.plain_text:
When Sándor Csányi took charge of OTP Bank, Hungary’s former state savings institution was entering privatisation. He cut management ranks, backed a modern electronic account system and expanded card services. Those measures helped preserve the bank’s domestic position before he led acquisitions across Central and Eastern Europe. Management participation in OTP’s share sales became the foundation of his fortune.

Capital released from OTP shares financed a vertically integrated agriculture and food group spanning crops, livestock, dairy products, meat processing and wine. Csányi also carried financial and operating expertise into public sporting work as president of the Hungarian Football Federation. That role grew into service as UEFA treasurer and a FIFA vice-president.
